title: Release notes: bind feedback and retrospective evidence
spec: The release CLI drafts release notes but ignores post-release learning: retrospective, PR, deploy, and feedback evidence files are never referenced, so release notes cannot prove what feedback the release incorporated. Extend the release tool so evidence can be supplied (individual files and/or a directory), gets summarized into the release note draft, and missing evidence categories are explicitly called out instead of silently omitted.
